field_text_formatted.value: The preview URL used the wrong query parameter (#3376193, patch by jeffschuler). The Views UI preview panel was reading an exposed filter's field name instead of its configured identifier, breaking any view where you'd renamed a filter to something readable. It now reads the identifier the display is actually configured with.
